method: Partial multistep prediction (Gromov–Baranov), perturbed trajectories, terminal avg and rgdbscan; daily trading adaptation
universe_rationale: Fixed convenience panel: three individual US stocks, two broad equity ETFs, long Treasury ETF, physical-gold ETF. All existed before2005. These are known surviving instruments, not a survivorship-free or representative universe of all stocks. No replacements or choosing best assets after results.
prior_information: BTC and other crypto strategy results for2022–2025 and Jan–Oct2026 are already known. This extension evaluates new instruments in correlated macro periods, not a fully independent prospective confirmation. All strategy results for these seven instruments are unopened at protocol creation.
data_source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint snapshot: daily split-adjusted OHLC, splits and dividends. Endpoint is not a guaranteed documented API. Preserve raw responses and checksums, cross-check corporate actions against issuer information.
calendar: XNYS regular-session dates using exchange_calendars; US equity/ETF holiday dates shared by this panel. Match all observed sessions; no weekend or holiday forward fills. Incomplete scheduled sessions fail data audit.
forecast_price: Split-adjusted Close, not dividend-adjusted total return. Normalize minmax only within each training window; no clipping. The model does not receive future dividend schedule.
parameter_policy: Reuse BTC-selected L/K, Wishart r/mu, radius, DBSCAN, noise variance, paths without new tuning. Separate published-geometry control from experiment.PAPER. Temporal settings deliberately changed before evaluation:2520 daily sessions of training,5-session horizon, weekly decisions and13-prior-week target control.
refit: quarterly before first quarterly decision, excluding all observations at/after quarter boundary
decision: After close of last scheduled session of each exchange week, including shortened holiday weeks; never infer weekly endpoint from a truncated observations array.
execution: Next scheduled real session Open. Additional one-session execution delay is a fixed sensitivity. Long/cash, no leverage or shorting,95% target on accepted forecast price return>0.003; otherwise0. Unchanged targets hold shares, except weekly-rebalanced causal exposure and volatility controls.
dividends: Separate ledger. Prior-close holdings earn cash dividend before ex-date opening orders: seller at ex-open entitled, buyer at ex-open not entitled. Primary assumes cash available on ex-date because provider lacks payment dates. Prespecified30-calendar-day settlement sensitivity recognizes receivable in equity but excludes it from buying power; it is a timing assumption, not actual payment-date reconstruction.
splits: Use constant split-adjusted share units for fractional execution, equivalent to raw prices and changing shares under proportional costs. Dividend units must match price units; verify AAPL before/after splits with issuer. Save full split events through snapshot cutoff; reconstruct raw prices/quantities for independent accounting. No synthetic total-return execution prices.
terminal: Liquidation is scheduled before last session Open in the fixed evaluation calendar. Report cash and pending dividends separately; final equity includes receivables. No dividends earned after liquidation.
forest: 200 trees,max_depth6,min_samples_leaf50,max_features0.8,seed42; quarterly fit on prior2520 sessions, purge5-session labels; features lagged price/volume/volatility only; same weekly decisions and trade rule.
causal_control: Mean of13 preceding weekly targets of main method; same weekly decisions/nextOpen execution; weekly rebalance. Actual exposure reported for both; not exact equality of every risk budget.
primary_estimand: 2026Jan–Oct class-balanced mean of per-instrument daily ES95(method)-ES95(causal_control): each of5equity instruments weight1/15,TLT1/3,GLD1/3. Negative favors method. This is mean instrument-level risk, not risk of a portfolio.
metrics: Session returns only,annualization sqrt252; ES95 mean loss in worst ceil(0.05*n) sessions floored0, max drawdown close equity, net return,CAGR,mean actual exposure,entries,turnover,costs,dividends,cash and receivables. No weekend zeros in ES. No tax/account-specific financing claims.

bootstrap.method: Paired circular blocks synchronized across all7instruments and bothstrategies; class-weighted aggregate95%CI, per-instrument Bonferroni7 intervals alpha=0.05/7; other comparisons descriptive.

activity: Publish forecast coverage and actual exposure; zero/low exposure is not evidence of risk recognition. All selected instruments remain in fixed aggregate.
stopping: Run all seven instruments and all declared comparisons. No new tuning, representations, assets, dates, costs or thresholds chosen from results; publish negative/inconclusive outcomes. Any later revision of trading policy needs a new evaluation.
